items.title: The first 21 chapters of Quarterback of the Future are available
items.text: For the 25th anniversary of the launch of PFT, I decided to post the rewritten Quarterback of the Future — one chapter per day.

items.title: Jerry Jones on fan's death after fight at 49ers-Cowboys game: "We had no record of an incident"
items.text: This week, a fan died after falling during a fight at AT&T Stadium.

items.title: Tom Brady, after selling Birmingham City stake, buys piece of Chelsea
items.text: Tom Brady's exit from the English soccer business was only temporary.

items.title: Daiyan Henley being out with a knee injury changes nothing about the failed trade to Broncos
items.text: The failed trade of Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley returned to the front burner on Friday, with the news that Henley will miss Sunday's game against the Jets due to a knee injury.

items.title: Raiders owner Mark Davis hated the Madden movie
items.text: Did anyone read the script before allowing the Raiders' name and logo to be used?

items.title: NFL didn't know Puka Nacua had surgery when agreeing to suspension
items.text: The sudden decision of the NFL to suspend receiver Puka Nacua three games raises plenty of relevant questions.

items.title: Philadelphia mayor wants the Eagles to play in a dome
items.text: The Eagles will become an indoor team if the mayor of Philadelphia gets her way.

items.title: Jaguars saw something in Liam Coen that other teams didn't
items.text: The Jaguars identified Coen as their No. 1 candidate and re-shaped their front office to get him, at a time when other teams weren't even interviewing him.

items.title: Bud Dupree requests release from Chargers, who haven't granted it
items.text: As the season continues to unfold — and as the trade deadline fades into the rear-view mirror — unhappy players have only one option: To request a release.

items.title: Puka Nacua will undergo knee surgery and likely miss the rest of the season
items.text: Sean McVay says Nacua will miss "a couple months."

items.title: Nicolas Cage on his John Madden misfire: "I'm not Frank Caliendo"
items.text: This whole thing is antithetical to my identity.

items.title: Carson Beck listed as questionable, but Josh Johnson is expected to start
items.text: Josh Johnson is expected to start Sunday's game against the Chiefs, but the Cardinals have not ruled out Carson Beck.

items.title: Brock Bowers doesn't know whether he will play Sunday
items.text: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

items.title: S Talanoa Hufanga, WR Jaylen Waddle, CB Riley Moss set to return Sunday
items.text: The Broncos' injury report Friday was not about who has a status, but who doesn't.

items.title: Colts officially place Daniel Jones on waivers
items.text: Daniel Jones is officially on the waiver wire.

items.title: Chargers rule out LB Daiyan Henley, list WR Ladd McConkey as questionable
items.text: Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley missed practice this week with knee soreness, and the team has ruled him out for Sunday's game against the Jets.

items.title: NFL will consider requiring minimum-night stays for international games
items.text: After the 49ers and the Rams took dramatically different approaches to their arrival in Melbourne for the first-ever Australia game, we raised the question of whether the league should require teams to get there early enough to advance the goal of promoting American football to international audiences.

items.title: Saints officially waive S Justin Reid
items.text: Safety Justin Reid already penned his good-bye missive to the Saints, but his departure did not become official until 4 p.m.

items.title: Commanders add RB Rachaad White to the injury report as limited with a heel injury
items.text: The Commanders added running back Rachaad White to the injury report Friday.

items.title: Brock Bowers, Matt Gay questionable for Raiders-Broncos
items.text: There’s a chance quarterback Fernando Mendoza will have his top target for his second start.

items.title: Panthers LB Bobby Okereke will miss a third consecutive game
items.text: Panthers linebacker Bobby Okereke will miss his third consecutive game with a foot injury.

items.title: Fan dies after falling during a fight at 49ers-Cowboys game
items.text: A man who attended Sunday's game between the 49ers and Cowboys has died due to injuries sustained in a fight during the game.

items.title: DeVonta Smith set to return; Zack Baun, Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for Eagles
